licenses.note: The reference is Minecraft 1.20.6 itself, the game the loader runs, so there is no build to install and nothing to download beyond the game.

deviations.what: The elytra cannot be equipped and a player cannot glide, so grug:elytra is an item that can be held and does nothing else. It has no durability use either, which needs the same equipment slot.
deviations.why: mod_api.json has no entry for a player's equipment slots, for an item stack's damage, or for a player's velocity and look angle, and no Item export runs on a tick or on a right click. The reference equips the elytra in the chest slot from ElytraItem.use, spends its durability from elytraFlightTick, and gets its glide physics from LivingEntity.travel's isFallFlying branch.

deviations.what: grug:firework_rocket is an item with no behaviour: it cannot be launched and gives no boost to a gliding player, where the reference's FireworkRocketEntity rides a gliding player and adds look * 0.1 + (look * 1.5 - velocity) * 0.5 to their velocity every tick.
deviations.why: No host function spawns a vanilla rocket or makes a spawned entity boost the player it rides, gliding itself is not ported yet, and mod_api.json has no particle support for the rocket's trail.

deviations.what: Neither item plays a sound. The reference plays item.armor.equip_elytra when the elytra goes into the chest slot, item.elytra.flying while a player glides, and entity.firework_rocket.launch and the blast sounds for a rocket.
deviations.why: mod_api.json has no sound host function at all, and Alpha, Beta and 1.2.5 predate these sound events, so a port has to ship the .ogg files and a sounds.json of its own as it ships textures.
